subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should OpenClaw change Xiaomi pay-as-you-go and Token Plan fresh onboarding defaults to `mimo-v2.5`, or should this PR be narrowed to catalog-only V2.5 availability?
rationale: The implementation stays in the right plugin/docs/test boundary, but changing provider defaults is an upgrade-sensitive product choice that proof and CI cannot approve on their own.

options.title: Sponsor V2.5 Defaults
options.body: Accept `mimo-v2.5` as the new fresh/no-primary default for both Xiaomi providers, then have the branch conflict resolved before merge.

options.title: Request Catalog-Only Rows
options.body: Keep the pay-as-you-go V2.5 catalog and docs additions but revert the two default constant changes until a separate default decision lands.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Routing Work
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader Xiaomi V2.5 and multimodal-routing issue decides whether catalog/default work should land separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor V2.5 Defaults
recommendation.body: Accept `mimo-v2.5` as the new fresh/no-primary default for both Xiaomi providers, then have the branch conflict resolved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Token Plan V2.5 onboarding/catalog behavior closest to the default choice changed here.
